question.problem:
Consider the equivalence relation $∼$ on $R,$ defined by $x∼y$ if $\sqrt[3]{x}=\sqrt[3]{y}.$ Which of the following equivalence classes contain the element $64?$

I. $[64]$

II. $[-64]$

III. $[8]$
question.worked_solution:
We have $64\in [x]$ if $64∼x.$ Using the definition of the given equivalence relation, we require

$$
\begin{aligned}\sqrt[3]{64} & =\sqrt[3]{x} \\ 4 & =\sqrt[3]{x} \\ \sqrt[3]{x} & =4.\end{aligned}
$$

Let's now consider each of the given equivalence classes.

- $64\in [64]$ because $\sqrt[3]{64}=4\,✓$

- $64\notin [-64]$ because $\sqrt[3]{-64}=-4\ne 4\,\times $

- $64\notin [8]$ because $\sqrt[3]{8}=2\ne 4\,\times $

Therefore, the correct answer is "I only".
